name: Ensrick's Portrait Pack
description: These portraits were created using a combination of Photoshop and hundreds of AI images for layers via the KREA.AI website's realtime image to image, upscaler, and editor tools. The models used were Flux, Nano-Banana, and KREA.AI's HD model.
author: Ensrick
